CIV.note: ANSUT's central datacentre is described as serving the administration's shared network, not as rented to outside customers.
Only mobile coverage rates and the backbone are given; no rural programme with counted sites and no rural-urban use figures.
States ANSUT's profit and turnover only, no budget line, fund or spending report.
Mentions eGOUV programmes and prefecture connections but no online service or portal.

facts.fact: The article says ANSUT had completed 5,476 km of fibre and 66 cut points of its planned 7,000 km national high-speed backbone (RNHD) in 2023.
The article says 2,245 km of the ANSUT backbone is operated by Orange CI, MTN CI and Moov Africa CI.

CIV.note: Central datacentre is not stated to be for hire or to host government data.
